- **probability**: keeps the density-witness, module/blockade/pure-pair/comb/restriction/sparsification and quantitative induced-density (log-log bound) development; co-Bird combs yield anticonnected overlap classes and pure blockades with $E$-free patterns feeding the special-vertex criterion; closes both deductions (pendant-leaf reductions $E\to P_5$, Bird → bull; generalized niceness + wonderful + leaf-reducibility ⇒ Erdős–Hajnal property), with exponents left unspecified.
- **ordinals-and-cardinals**: keeps the ordinal, large-cardinal, forcing and choice-strength strands; adds Easton class forcing realising monotone continuum values at infinite regular cardinals under the cofinality constraint with singular cardinals excluded, and the characteristic numbers $\mathfrak p,\mathfrak t,\mathfrak b,\mathfrak d,\mathfrak s,\mathfrak r$ with the null/meagre cardinals and the Cichoń diagram.
